description: Criminal-law questions written by the project owner on 2026-11-06, BEFORE criminal law was added to NyayaAI. Text kept exactly as written. Expected sections are added only after checking them against the official Act text, and are never changed to improve scores.
questions: My neighbour filed a police complaint accusing me of stealing his expensive laptop. I have CCTV footage proving that I was not even present at his house that day. What can I do against a false criminal complaint? Can I take legal action against him?

Police officers came to my house and arrested my brother without explaining the reason. They have not allowed us to contact a lawyer or informed us about where he is being taken. What are his legal rights after arrest, and what can our family do?

Three people attacked me while I was walking home at night. I hit one of them with a nearby object to escape, and he suffered serious injuries. Can I claim the right of private defence under Indian criminal law? Could I still be arrested?

Someone posted false allegations about me on Instagram, claiming that I committed fraud. The post has damaged my reputation and affected my professional opportunities. Can I file a criminal defamation case in India? What remedies are available?

My former friend is threatening to leak my private photographs unless I pay him ₹50,000. He has sent these threats over WhatsApp. What criminal provisions protect me, and what should I do immediately?

During an argument, my neighbour punched me and caused injuries to my face. I have medical records and CCTV footage. Can I file an FIR, what offences might apply, and what happens after I file the complaint?

Someone called me pretending to be a bank employee and convinced me to share an OTP. ₹45,000 was transferred from my bank account without my permission. What criminal offences may apply, how do I report this, and can I recover my money?
note: Questions 6-7 added by the owner on 2026-11-06, also before criminal law was connected to answering.
